changelog:
- Plugin 0.13.0: guide for the Body editor, summary vs meta description, templates and menu [skip netlify]
- Body editor: headings H2-H6, B/I/U, lists, links and an insert-table button (no alignment, quote or line); tables scroll sideways on phones; H6 style
- Meta description and TL;DR are separate: description = own text, else the Content mask with variables, else nothing; score and admin preview no longer use the summary
- No page description at all when nothing is written and WordPress has no text to give
- TL;DR block only shows a written summary; WordPress's automatic excerpt is no longer used
- Byline text always left-aligned, also inside the centred header
- Fix FAQ and other meta values being saved empty when they contain quotes; Full width template; build assets served locally; dev server notices new articles
- Fix image picker: 'close' fires before 'select', so every picked image was discarded
- Header menu only from the Content tab; no menu and no empty container when empty
- Top bar: HTML on the right, spaces kept while typing, shorter copy with a Content tab link; fix meta values with quotes being saved empty
- Dev server re-reads WordPress Content/Styles on change (dev only)
